name: GalaxyCon Raleigh
blurb: A four-day Raleigh festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers, cosplayers and tattoo artists.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON RALEIGH ... July 29-August 1, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you again July 29-August 1, 2027 at the Atlantic Union Bank Convention Center ... 500 S Salisbury St Raleigh, NC 27601'

notes: Guest cards show only a name and attendance days (no bio text), so Known for is left blank throughout except #33 whose card literally adds 'WWE Icon Braun Strowman'; #34's card says only 'Kofi', expanded here to his well-known ring name Kofi Kingston (same person, not a guess) [both #33/#34 since dropped, see recheck below]. The guests page's 62 image candidates include a 7-person 'Cancellations' carousel (Danny Glover, Barry Bostwick, Matthew Lillard, plus reused photos of Eugene Cordero, Tawny Newsome, LaRue's Beehive and Soundwave) confirmed via the live page and excluded per 'skip guests marked cancelled'; the two 'Authentication' cards (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are graded-card/collectibles services, not individual guests, so they're excluded as vendor-like. #20's filename says 'DG CHICHESTER/SalvadorLarroca' but the card's own displayed name is 'Salvador Larroca', which is what's used. Four tattoo artists named on the live page (Brett Burleigh, Ed Ratcliff, Nina Bonanni, Midge O'Brien) had no image in the rendered candidate list, so they're recorded as textOnlyGuests [since dropped, see recheck below]. Cover uses the Raleigh wordmark logo since the homepage's og/hero images are a shared 11-city GalaxyCon promo graphic, a plain abstract-galaxy background, decorative cutout props, or ticket-sale banners rather than edition-specific key art. Guest-freshness recheck (verify-06, 2026-10-05): this guests page is a running, uncleared roster, not a clean per-edition list — every candidate's own image filename carries a year stamp, and only Eugene Cordero, Tawny Newsome, James Marsters, Anne Yatco, Lex Lang, Adam McArthur, Kaiji Tang, Cristina Vee, Robbie Daymond and Zach Aguilar are tagged '2027-GC-…'; the other candidates kept in the original pick (Daniel Ross through Nycole Fox, plus JSA/Agents of Slabs) are tagged '2025-GC-…' or '2026-GC-…', i.e. left over from the prior two Raleigh editions with no announcement yet for 2027, so they are removed along with the four unverifiable text-only tattoo artists. Bob West and Sid Krofft keep no dated filename but are independently corroborated as 2027 Raleigh guests by the convention-tracking site RosterCon (rostercon.com/en/event-convention/galaxycon-raleigh-2027), so they stay. Trimmed from 53 lineup picks + 4 text-only (57) down to these 12 confirmed guests.
